map.上染率和固色率有什么区别？: What is the difference between dye uptake and fixation?
map.上染率固色率计算 使用指南: How to use the dye uptake and fixation calculator
map.上染率固色率计算器，输入染前染后染液浓度按吸尽率法求上染率与固色率，评估染色效果: The dye uptake and fixation calculator takes the dye bath concentration before and after dyeing and uses the exhaustion method to get the uptake and fixation rates, assessing the dyeing result.
map.上染率是染液中被纤维吸尽的比例；固色率是已与纤维化学键合、耐皂洗不掉的比例。固色: Uptake is the share of the dye bath exhausted onto the fibre; fixation is the share chemically bonded to the fibre and resistant to soaping. Fixation <= uptake, and the difference is the unfixed loose dye.
map.染料配方筛选与对比：不同配方/温度/电解质下的上染率、固色率横向比较择优。: Dye formula screening and comparison: compare the uptake and fixation rates across formulas, temperatures and electrolytes side by side to pick the best.
map.染色质量控制：固色率偏低提示浮色多、皂洗负担重，需调整工艺。: Dyeing quality control: a low fixation rate means much loose dye and a heavy soaping load, so the process needs adjusting.
map.活性染料浸染工艺评估：上染率反映纤维吸尽染料的占比，固色率反映真正固着的部分。: Reactive dye exhaust process assessment: the uptake rate is the share of dye exhausted onto the fibre and the fixation rate is the part actually fixed.
map.活性黑浸染上染率固色率测算: Reactive black exhaust uptake and fixation calculation
map.浓度怎么测得准确？: How is the concentration measured accurately?
map.视染料与工艺，浸染活性染料固色率常要求 60%~80% 以上；具体以产品标准与成: Depending on the dye and process, exhaust dyeing with reactive dyes usually requires a fixation rate of 60%-80% or more. Follow the product standard and the cost trade-off; this tool is a reference for estimation.
map.通常用分光光度法测染液吸光度由标准曲线换算浓度；残液与皂洗液需充分取样混匀，避免: Usually the dye bath concentration is measured by spectrophotometry from absorbance through a standard curve; the residual bath and soaping liquor must be sampled and mixed well to avoid colourimetric error.
map.：初始染液浓度 C0、残液 C1、皂洗残液 C2，按 上染率=(1-C1/C0): : with initial bath concentration C0, residual C1 and soaping liquor C2, uptake=(1-C1/C0)×100% and fixation=(C0-C1-C2)/C0×100%. With C0=2.0, C1=0.3, C2=0.4 g/L the uptake is 85% and the fixation 65%.
